card.title: IPhone 12 and Above WiFi IC Replacement & Activation

source.title: IPhone 12 and Above WiFi IC Replacement & Activation

claims.statement: From iPhone 12 on the Wi-Fi IC is paired; replacing it requires removing the NAND and running JC Query Code/Unbind, then activating a JC programmable Wi-Fi IC on the V1S Pro.
Where the Wi-Fi IC is on the lower board, power the board in an iSocket to activate.

procedure: Rule out shorts and interposer breaks.
Remove the Wi-Fi IC and NAND.
Query Code/Unbind the NAND; refit NAND.
Activate a JC Wi-Fi IC with the phone connected.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
